_comment: Golden vectors for the query-surface prototype (toy).
Each entry is the canonical form of ONE logical plan. Every front end that
claims to express the query must canonicalize to the byte-identical string.
This file is the SHARED referent: the F# CE test and the C# LINQ tests all
read it, so a drift in either front end fails against the same artifact
rather than against a constant copied into two places.
Regenerate by printing ToyPlan.canonical for the plan in question.

filter-project-join.sql: SELECT c.Name, o.Amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.Cust = c.Id WHERE o.Amount > 100

stream-table-join.sql:
SELECT c.Name, o.Amount FROM orders o JOIN customers
c ON o.Cust = c.Id

join-project.sql: SELECT c.Name, o.Amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.Cust = c.Id
join-project._comment: No WHERE between join and select, so C# fuses the projection into the join's result selector. Unfused back to Codd join-then-project, this is the plan the F# CE produces for `join` followed by `select`.
